# ts23d

> @developerz-ai/ts23d — a free, deterministic 3D asset generator driven by coding agents. Assets are TypeScript modules (never JSON) built with a DSL: `defineAsset({ name, kind, real, sources, budget, build(ctx) })`, where `build` adds named, pivoted, animatable parts from primitives (`box`, `lathe`, `cylinder`, `prism`, `beam`, `planar`), places detail with `place`/`merge`, composes other assets with `ctx.use`, and gates detail on `ctx.lod`. It compiles to glTF/GLB (3 LODs, one shared trim-sheet material, baked motion), fails a QA gate on floating parts, budget overruns and wrong real-world proportions, and renders a zero-GPU six-view contact-sheet PNG so a vision-capable agent can check its own work. Bun only, zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Status 0.x: stubs throw T3D_NOT_IMPLEMENTED with the roadmap slice that builds them.

## Offline (inside your project)
The npm package ships every doc, skill and example, versioned with the code — read them without internet:
- `node_modules/@developerz-ai/ts23d/AGENTS.md` — rules and the loop
- `node_modules/@developerz-ai/ts23d/docs/` — DSL, IR, materials, agent loop, QA, kinds, decisions, roadmap
- `node_modules/@developerz-ai/ts23d/recipes/` + `refs/` — idiomatic recipes and their research dossiers
- `node_modules/@developerz-ai/ts23d/.claude/skills/author-recipe/SKILL.md` — copy into your `.claude/skills/`

## The workflow
The human names a thing ("Tiger I, mid-production 1943"). The agent researches specs and real photos into `refs/<name>.md` (every number sourced), writes `recipes/<name>.ts` with `sources` + `real.measures` from that dossier, compiles until QA PASS (budget, surface contact, clashes, proportions ±5%, measures ±2%), renders the six-view contact sheet, looks at it, adds LOD-gated detail, and iterates.

- [IR, units, axes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/03-ir.md)
- [Materials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/04-materials.md): trim sheet, palettes, generator, image sources (kubeez.com)
- [Agent loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/05-agent-loop.md): contact sheet layout, iteration
- [QA gates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/06-qa.md)
- [What fits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/07-what-fits.md): hard-surface vs organic; creatures via SDF kind or local-GPU adapters
- [Kinds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/09-kinds.md): buildings, vehicles, vessels, vegetation, scenes
